description:
Account in Judaeo-Arabic. In the hand of ʿArūs b. Yosef. Headed by a mention of Abū l-Ḥusayn al-Ṣayrafī (the banker, maybe the well-known Aleppan banker Abū l-Husayn Yaḥyā active in this period) and followed by reference to numerous ruqʿas (here referring to orders of payment, probably).

May join with JRL B 2661 (PGPID 28468).
description_he: חשבון ביהודית-ערבית, המזכיר אבו אל-חסן אל-צירפי.
